about.sectionTitle: How did Spim na Rabí come to be?
about.p1: Rabí and its surroundings are a place close to our hearts since childhood. This is where we spent many wonderful moments and always loved coming back to.
about.p2: When we thought about where to create a place to rest, the decision was actually easy. We wanted to offer accommodation where guests feel at ease, slow down, and have the perfect base for discovering the beauty of Šumava.
about.p3: We furnished Spim na Rabí the way we would love to travel ourselves – comfortably, cosily, and without the unnecessary. We would be delighted if you enjoy your stay with us and take home memories as fond as the ones we have of this place.

pricing.intro: The minimum length of stay is 2 nights. On request, we will happily prepare breakfast for you. Pets are welcome for a fee of 250 CZK / night.

footer.tagline: Accommodation beneath Rabí Castle. Calm, nature, rest.

studio-3.desc: A cosy studio for up to 4 guests. Ideal for those seeking simplicity, peace, and comfort.

loft-10.desc: A spacious loft for up to 6 guests, with plenty of room for a family or a longer stay. A blend of comfort and airy space.

gdpr.title: Privacy Policy
gdpr.intro: Your privacy matters to us. Below we explain what personal data we process, for what purpose, and what rights you have. The data controller is the operator of the Spim na Rabí accommodation, Rabí 175, 342 01 Rabí.

sections.heading: What data we process
sections.body: We process the data you provide when making a reservation or contacting us – name, email, phone, dates of stay, number of guests, and any note. We also process the data required for the guest register mandated by law.

sections.heading: Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: We use your data to process and confirm your reservation, to communicate with you before and after your stay, and to fulfil the legal obligations of an accommodation operator. The legal basis is the performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, and our legitimate interest in providing the service properly.

sections.heading: Retention period
sections.body: We retain personal data only for as long as strictly necessary – for the duration of the reservation and thereafter for the period required by law (in particular accounting and tax regulations).

sections.heading: Sharing of data
sections.body: We do not share your data with third parties, except for providers essential to our operation (e.g. email and hosting services) and cases where the law requires it. We do not sell your data.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict processing, to data portability, and to object. You can contact us at any time at spimnarabi@seznam.cz. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern reservations and stays at the Spim na Rabí accommodation, Rabí 175, 342 01 Rabí. By creating a reservation, you agree to them.

sections.heading: Reservation
sections.body: A reservation is made by submitting the reservation form and our confirmation of it by email. The minimum length of stay is 2 nights. Please provide accurate and complete information.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
sections.body: Prices are per apartment per night and follow the current price list. Pets are welcome for a surcharge of 250 CZK / night. We will inform you of the payment method and deadline in the reservation confirmation.

sections.heading: Arrival and departure
sections.body: Check-in is from 3:00 PM and check-out is until 11:00 AM, unless otherwise agreed. We will send you information about key pickup and parking by email the day before your arrival.

sections.heading: House rules
sections.body: Smoking is prohibited throughout the building, and quiet hours apply from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Guests are responsible for any damage caused during their stay. Please treat the furnishings with care.

sections.heading: Cancellation
sections.body: Cancellation terms and any cancellation fees are governed by our cancellation policy. Please contact us as early as possible if needed.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.intro: We understand that plans can change. Below you will find the terms for cancelling a confirmed reservation at the Spim na Rabí accommodation.

sections.heading: Free cancellation
sections.body: You may cancel your reservation free of charge no later than 14 days before your arrival date. In that case, we will refund the full amount paid.

sections.heading: Cancellation fees
sections.body: For cancellations 13 to 7 days before arrival, the cancellation fee is 50% of the price of the stay. For cancellations less than 7 days before arrival, or in the case of a no-show, the cancellation fee is 100% of the price of the stay.

sections.heading: How to cancel
sections.body: To cancel your reservation, write to us at spimnarabi@seznam.cz or call +420 723 936 426. The time of cancellation is the moment your notice reaches us.

sections.heading: Exceptional circumstances
sections.body: In the case of serious and documented reasons, we will always try to find an accommodating solution. Do not hesitate to contact us.
